name: world_truth_track
title: World truth track, format version 2
description: Every vehicle SUMO had, at each sampled SUMO frame inside the capture window, drawn or not: one row per vehicle per sample, in order of sumo_id within a sample. A capture's truth sidecars list the vehicles a frame drew; this lists what the world contained. Rows join to a sidecar's vehicle events by sumo_id and frame. An empty cell is a missing value. The format version is the one the summary beside the track declares in world_truth_track_version; this schema describes version 2.

fields.name: time_utc
fields.description: The row's instant as a UTC time, from the scenario's epoch: the simulated civil time, not the wall clock. Empty where the run declared no epoch.

fields.name: sim_time_s
fields.description: Simulated time of the SUMO frame the row describes, on TraCI's clock.

fields.name: uid
fields.description: The vehicle's track identifier, CARLA-TRUTH-SUMO-<sumo_id>: the uid a capture sidecar gives the same vehicle.

fields.name: callsign
fields.description: <base_type>-<sumo_id>, as a capture sidecar's callsign.

fields.name: cot_type
fields.description: The Cursor-on-Target type: a ground vehicle of neutral affiliation.

fields.name: how
fields.description: How the position was obtained: m-g, machine generated.

fields.name: lat
fields.description: Latitude, WGS84, of the point on the ground under the vehicle's front bumper.

fields.name: lon
fields.description: Longitude, WGS84, of the same point.

fields.name: hae_m
fields.description: Height above the WGS84 ellipsoid of the bare-earth ground under that point. Empty where the vehicle stands off the world's ground grid.

fields.name: ce_m
fields.description: Circular error. Always 0: truth.

fields.name: le_m
fields.description: Linear error. Always 0: truth.

fields.name: course_deg
fields.description: SUMO's heading for the vehicle, clockwise from true north.

fields.name: speed_mps
fields.description: SUMO's speed for the vehicle.

fields.name: vx
fields.description: Velocity east, from SUMO's speed and heading, in CARLA's frame (x east, y south).

fields.name: vy
fields.description: Velocity south, from SUMO's speed and heading.

fields.name: vz
fields.description: Velocity up. Always 0: SUMO moves vehicles on the plane.

fields.name: base_type
fields.description: The vehicle's base type, such as car, van or truck: the vehicle catalogue's for the blueprint its SUMO type names, or the one its SUMO vehicle class maps to.

fields.name: type_id
fields.description: The SUMO vehicle type. A capture sidecar calls this vtype_id; its own type_id is the CARLA blueprint.

fields.name: special_type
fields.description: The vehicle's kind from the catalogue. Empty where it has none.

fields.name: length_m
fields.description: The length the SUMO type declares, which SUMO's car-following used.

fields.name: width_m
fields.description: The width the SUMO type declares.

fields.name: height_m
fields.description: The height the SUMO type declares.

fields.name: color
fields.description: The SUMO type's color, red,green,blue, each 0 to 255.

fields.name: role_name
fields.description: The SUMO flow the vehicle came from: its id up to the last dot, or the whole id where it has none.

fields.name: edge
fields.description: The SUMO edge the vehicle was on.

fields.name: lane
fields.description: The SUMO lane the vehicle was on. Empty where it was on none, as a vehicle parked off the road is.

fields.name: sumo_x
fields.description: Position east in SUMO's network coordinates.

fields.name: sumo_y
fields.description: Position north in SUMO's network coordinates.

fields.name: carla_x
fields.description: Position east in CARLA's frame: sumo_x.

fields.name: carla_y
fields.description: Position south in CARLA's frame: minus sumo_y.

fields.name: sumo_id
fields.description: The SUMO vehicle: the key that joins the row to the sidecars and the supervision plan.

fields.name: entity_id
fields.description: The vehicle's entity id, which is its SUMO id.

fields.name: frame
fields.description: The CARLA frame that rendered this SUMO frame.

fields.name: render_state
fields.description: rendered where a body drew the vehicle on the frame; simulated_only where none did.

fields.name: render_reason
fields.description: Why no body drew the vehicle, the first that holds: no_world, the run renders no world; outside_limit, an optional render-set limit left it no body; no_blueprint or unknown_extent, its type has no measured body; no_ground, it stands off the world's ground grid; not_drawn, none of those. Empty where it was rendered.

fields.name: actor_id
fields.description: The body that drew the vehicle. Empty where none did.

fields.name: in_window
fields.description: Always 1: the track holds only frames inside the capture window.

fields.name: sun_elevation_deg
fields.description: The sun's geometric elevation the world reported on the frame's tick. Empty where it reported none.

fields.name: sun_corrected_elevation_deg
fields.description: The sun's refraction-corrected elevation, where the world's reading carries it.

fields.name: illumination_band
fields.description: The sun's illumination band, cut as a capture's is, by the sun's refraction-corrected elevation in degrees: day above 6, golden above 0, civil_twilight above -6, nautical_twilight above -12, astronomical_twilight above -18, night at -18 and below. Empty where there is no sun.

fields.name: illumination_band_elevation
fields.description: Which elevation the band was cut from: refraction_corrected wherever the reading carries it.
